cards.q: What is a WAN Edge in SD-WAN?
cards.a: The SD-WAN term for the routers at each site — vEdge (Viptela OS) or cEdge (IOS-XE). They terminate overlay tunnels, run OMP with vSmart, forward data via secure DTLS/IPsec, and enforce app-aware policies.

cards.q: What are the roles of a WAN edge router?
cards.a: Tunnel termination (DTLS/IPsec), running OMP with vSmart for control, forwarding overlay data, applying local policy from templates, and supporting multi-WAN transport.

cards.q: How do vEdge and cEdge differ?
cards.a: cEdge is an IOS-XE router (Catalyst/ISR) running SD-WAN; vEdge is Viptela-native hardware/virtual running Viptela OS. Config differs (IOS-XE SD-WAN vs SD-WAN CLI), both interoperate natively.

cards.q: What is a TLOC and color in SD-WAN?
cards.a: A TLOC (transport locator) identifies a transport connection, and color labels it (e.g. MPLS/broadband); each TLOC + color is a potential path, and SLA measures path health.

cards.q: What are the four session types a WAN edge maintains?
cards.a: vBond (onboarding), vSmart (OMP), vManage (management), and peers (edge-to-edge tunnels).

cards.q: Where does the SD-WAN data plane actually live?
cards.a: On the WAN edge routers (vEdge/cEdge); data is encrypted in DTLS/IPsec tunnels and SLA-routed between edges.

cards.q: Which commands verify a WAN edge?
cards.a: show sdwan control connections, show sdwan control connections-history, show omp peers, show omp routes, show sdwan interface, and show sdwan running-config.

cards.q: A WAN edge has no control connections. What is the likely cause and check?
cards.a: A DTLS/NAT problem is likely; check show sdwan control connections.

cards.q: OMP is not coming up on the edge. What is the likely cause and check?
cards.a: vSmart reachability is likely; check show omp peers.

cards.q: A path fails SLA on the edge. What is the likely cause and check?
cards.a: A transport/SLA issue is likely; check show omp routes and the transport health.

cards.q: Field distinctions of the WAN Edge?
cards.a: WAN Edge is the data plane (vEdge/cEdge); cEdge is IOS-XE while vEdge is Viptela OS; transports are identified by TLOC + color; tunnels are DTLS/IPsec with app-aware policy.
